reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/lmsg.rs mixes borrowed default message/help pointers with individually allocated replacements, tracked by owned_messages and owned_help. lmsg_line stages a saved replacement before publishing the selected entry.
owner_creation.invariant: Ownership flags must identify exactly which selected pointers may be freed.
limitations: Default help image storage remains a separate owner from selected help_data.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/lmsg.rs lmsg returns a borrowed pointer from lmsgs, and lmsg_init documents that replacements invalidate earlier message/help aliases. Consumers cannot treat returned C strings as independent saved owners.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A borrowed message must not survive replacement of its selected entry.
limitations: The raw return type contains no borrow lifetime or replacement generation.

callback_targets.analysis: src/lmsg.rs lmsg_line directly invokes parsing, xbuffer and saven helpers while borrowing a caller FILE/line buffer. It retains copied text rather than storing a parser callback or stack-line pointer.
callback_targets.invariant: Published message bytes must be independent of parser scratch lifetimes.
limitations: Direct native calls still carry their declared C ABI contracts.

invalidation.analysis: src/lmsg.rs frees prior owned help before restoring the static fallback at initialization, and frees a previously owned message before installing its replacement. Both transitions expire earlier raw string aliases.
invalidation.invariant: Replacement must not leave outside borrowers using retired message bytes.
limitations: The startup-only contract is a precondition rather than a type-enforced exclusion.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/lmsg.rs saves candidate bytes before freeing an existing entry, then updates pointer, ownership flag and optional help length separately. This repairs prior owner orphaning but is not a whole-file atomic language switch.
mutation_commit.invariant: Pointer, length and ownership flag must agree after each entry commit.
limitations: M0-LEAK-005 remains open for maintained independent disposition.

release_pair.analysis: src/lmsg.rs frees only flag-owned replacements; lmsg_init deinitializes its temporary xbuffer and closes the file after reading. Borrowed defaults and the caller-supplied language path are not freed here.
release_pair.invariant: A free counterpart must follow ownership flags rather than pointer nonnull alone.
limitations: A persistent selected message is intentionally retained after parser scratch cleanup.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/lmsg.rs missing file or invalid entry reports and returns without a transactional rollback of earlier language entries. Empty text reaches saven with length zero; its current guard avoids strncpy on that null input, addressing the historical M0-FFI-002 mechanism.
error_cleanup.invariant: An empty allocation result must not imply a valid source pointer for native copy.
limitations: The repaired helper is source-inspected; the maintained finding is not closed.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/lmsg.rs requires initialization before retained command-loop message/help borrows and has no handler-safe replacement protocol. M0-MEM-001 remains open for raw consumer lifetimes across updates.
signals_handoff.invariant: Message replacement belongs to ordinary serialized startup/configuration work.
limitations: This packet establishes no direct handler route into lmsg_init.

src/pager.rs.relationship: saven at src/pager.rs:840-854 handles zero length before invoking native copy, bounding the historical empty-message source-pointer concern reached from lmsg_line.
